text:
Michael Amadio has 10 goals in 27 games, and a goal in three straight. By our wins-added count, which weighs each goal by how much it swung the game, he ranks 46th among 574 skaters: his goals have mattered. Not bad for a former third-round pick who won a Cup in Vegas as a depth forward.

Some of it will cool. He's shooting 25.6% against 16% last season, with 10 goals on 6.51 expected. Our talent range puts his real finishing closer to 15%, which means the goals will probably come slower.

But this isn't all luck. His chance rate has jumped from 0.64 expected goals per 60 last season to 0.89, and Ottawa has 56% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice. Evolving-Hockey liked his defense last season (93rd percentile), and noted he plays with strong teammates. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 57% of his shots coming off the rush. Ten points in his last ten games, on about 17 minutes a night, is a role, not a heater. Watch whether the minutes hold when the shooting cools.
